name: Transient excursions
summary: Marks the dates on which a field is briefly brighter in blue, or darker in blue and near infrared, than in the 15 days before and after, without the scene classification layer.
status: Tested on fields in Bahia, Mato Grosso and Paraná, from another reading of the same Sentinel-2 scenes: it accounts for 26 % to 62 % of the excess in the noise's heavy tail in Paraná, and for less than 10 % in Mato Grosso and Bahia. Whether it becomes a model of its own or part of Observation noise is not decided.
limits: Weak in Mato Grosso and Bahia, where most of the heavy tail is something it does not mark.
After the marked dates are removed, the noise still has a heavy tail in every region.
A date is marked only when it departs from both sides in the same direction, so a change that lasts, such as a harvest, is not marked.
